description: This file defines the ChartFrame class, which manages and renders one or more Chart objects within a PDF document, including drawing frames, positioning, and selecting appropriate chart renderers.

classes.name: ChartFrame
classes.description: Represents a drawable frame that contains and manages multiple charts within a PDF document.

methods.name: ChartFrame
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ChartFrame with a specified rectangle.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a Chart object to the ChartFrame.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Draws all charts within the frame, including the frame border and individual charts.

methods.name: DrawChart
methods.description: Draws only the first chart in the ChartFrame.

methods.name: GetChartRenderer
methods.description: Selects and returns the appropriate renderer for a given chart based on its type and series collection.
